test_cpp_python_best_response_oracle: test the BestResponseOracle class to verify cpp and py backends produce identical best response policies
create_BestResponseOracle_py: create a BestResponseOracle instance with best_response_backend set to 'py' for python-based best response computation
create_BestResponseOracle_cpp: create a BestResponseOracle instance with best_response_backend set to 'cpp' for C++-based best response computation
test_compute_states_and_info_states: test best_response.compute_states_and_info_states_if_none to compute game states and information state mappings
test_action_probabilities_comparison: test that py and cpp best response oracles return identical action probabilities across all game states
